reason: Health restore re-check (12 Nov 2026): no own site found (one search); her only site is Hendo Care Farm (hendocarefarm.com, robots allows), a therapeutic care farm in Hendersonville NC that she co-owns. The only spiritual practice she leads there is Farm Yoga with goats and pigs ($25, 90 minutes, private bookings for 3+, no dates) plus seasonal retreats with no future dates published, so too thin to list her for the practice alone. Contact is the farm's general inbox. Insight Timer @thehumanwifi (1.6k followers) not opened.
